assessments.rationale: Existing tests and source establish bounded separation of factual truth, witness interpretation, institutional judgment, crowd consensus and agency-known state, constructed-state persistence/output, and real week-close progression of explicitly seeded intake reports. They do not establish one controlled normal-play information-acquisition trajectory across all five layers. Synthetic corroboration and fixture history are not new observed world events; certainty hydration is not acquisition. Broader information visibility, provenance and release acceptance remain incomplete.

evidence.scope: Clean-subject execution passed 463 tests in eight existing files with Node 22.23.5, Vitest 5.1.0, CI=true and STRICT_TEST_CONSOLE=1. Source assessment maps actual assertions, five evidence conditions, exact commands and original artifact hashes; distinguishes seeded fixtures, isolated tests, source inspection and unavailable gameplay evidence. This complementary packet is not an integrated release census.
